summary: Retest of the CR-489 field-path fix. Both OrderEntry L365 and OrderCard L122 now read restaurant?.settings?.orderEditAccess. I logged in as owner@cafe103.com in the browser. The employee-orders-list API returned bill_print=Yes for 1537757, bill_print=No for 1537752, and bill_print=Yes for 1537753 (1537753 is now printed too). ORDER VIEW, PASS: order-card-1537757 shows only served-toggle and bill-btn. print-kot-btn and cancel-order-btn are hidden and Bill is visible. 1537753 (printed) is locked the same way, showing served-toggle and ready-btn with no KOT/Cancel. Unprinted 1537752 still shows merge, shift, food-transfer, item-action, print-kot, cancel and ready. The OrderCard lock now works. GAPS: (1) In Table View, TableCard has no lock. print-btn-wc-1537757 (Print KOT) is still visible on the printed order. TableCard has no merge/shift buttons, so the 'Merge/Shift hidden in Table View' item cannot be tested there. Merge/Shift exist only in OrderCard, where they are gated, and in OrderEntry. (2) OrderEntry for locked 1537757 still shows shift-table-btn, merge-tables-btn, reprint-kot-btn, the per-item edit pencils and Transfer, and the item catalogue for adding items. Only order cancel and item cancel are gated there.

ui_bugs.issue: The Print KOT IconButton is not gated by isEditLocked. It is visible on the bill-printed order 1537757 in Table View.

On a locked order (1537757) the shift-table-btn, merge-tables-btn, item edit (pencil), Transfer and add-item menu are still available. The spec says to block everything except Collect Payment and Reprint Bill.

action_items: Gate the TableCard Print KOT button (print-btn-{id}) with the same isEditLocked logic: restaurant.settings.orderEditAccess && table.billPrinted && !hasPermission('order_edit_access').
In OrderEntry, gate shift-table-btn, merge-tables-btn, food transfer, quantity edits, adding items and Update Order when isEditLocked is true, if the spec requires a full lock.
Decide whether reprint-kot-btn in OrderEntry should be allowed while locked. KOT is hidden on OrderCard but still shown in OrderEntry, which is inconsistent.
critical_code_review_comments: The isEditLocked expression is duplicated in OrderCard and OrderEntry, and TableCard needs it too. Extract a shared hook such as useIsEditLocked(order) to avoid future path drift.
orderData.billPrinted in OrderEntry is still a prop snapshot, so it will not update after printing the bill within the session.

success_rate.frontend: Core CR-489 OrderCard checks: 4 of 4 pass (KOT hidden, Cancel hidden, Bill visible, unprinted unchanged). Table View / OrderEntry lock coverage is incomplete.

seed_data_creation: None. Test was read-only, no orders modified.
